verdict.rationale: Bento documents a POST /batch/events endpoint that tracks a user's activity and triggers automations. Its workflows and flows are built from triggers including behavior and events, and first-party SDKs in many languages let a developer fire events from their product. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing a workflow trigger configured on an arbitrary custom event name and scoped to only the subscriber who sent it (only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
